bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for History Theatre to perform a play.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; HISTORY THEATRE. +]

[+$100,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to History Theatre to perform a play celebrating Hmong arts and culture. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for History Theatre to perform a play.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; HISTORY THEATRE.

$100,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to History Theatre to perform a play celebrating Hmong arts and culture.
additions: $100,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to History Theatre to perform a play celebrating Hmong arts and culture.
